name: Long Life
overview: The Scriptures reveal that long life is closely connected to obedience and reverence toward God and others, as honoring parents is promised to extend one’s days (Exodus 20:12). Serving the Lord faithfully brings blessings, including health and the removal of sickness (Exodus 23:25), while walking in God’s commands leads to well-being and prolonged life in the land He provides (Deuteronomy 5:33). Though human life is limited and marked by toil and sorrow (Psalms 90:10), God promises satisfaction through long life accompanied by the experience of His salvation (Psalms 91:16), enabling believers to live purposefully and declare His works (Psalms 118:17).
